title: European Parliament backs resolution urging a ban on biometric mass surveillance and predictive surveillance
summary: MEPs adopted, with 377 votes in favour, a report on AI in criminal law that asks EU lawmakers to ban automated recognition of people in public spaces, private facial-recognition databases and social scoring.

title: White House science office says it will develop an AI 'bill of rights' and opens public comment on biometric technologies
summary: The Office of Science and Technology Policy issued a request for information on AI-enabled biometric technologies, with comments due 15 January 2022.

title: Microsoft and Nvidia unveil Megatron-Turing NLG, a 530-billion-parameter language model
summary: The companies describe the model, trained with DeepSpeed and Megatron, as the largest generative language model of its type to date.

title: Facebook AI and university partners release Ego4D, a first-person video dataset of over 3,000 hours
summary: The Ego4D paper describes unscripted egocentric video from participants around the world, together with a benchmark suite for egocentric perception.

title: DeepMind makes the MuJoCo robotics physics simulator free to use
summary: DeepMind said it would open up the physics engine for robotics research, which it had acquired earlier in 2021, to all users at no cost.

title: NATO adopts its first AI strategy, with principles for responsible use in defence and security
summary: The alliance's strategy sets out principles of responsible use for AI in defence and security.

title: Russian AI alliance and government partners sign a 33-point voluntary AI ethics code
summary: Companies including Sber, Yandex, MTS and VK signed a recommendatory code of ethical principles for AI participants, to be overseen by a special commission, AdIndex reports.

title: Tesla halts FSD Beta 10.3 and recalls 11,704 vehicles over false emergency braking, per US safety filing
summary: According to the NHTSA recall document cited by ForkLog, the update broke the link between two chips; Tesla patched it on 25 October and halted the beta on 26 October, with no crashes or injuries linked to the fault.

title: Chile's science ministry presents its first national AI policy, a ten-year framework
summary: The policy has four cross-cutting principles, three interdependent axes and an accompanying action plan.
